운동을 시작하거나 지속할 의향은 있지만, 실제 행동으로 이어지는 과정에는: Intent is high but friction blocks action. In DooitSurvey, 67.7% meant to start or keep exercising, yet cited "too much bother" (79.3%), "no time" (37.1%), "hard and dull" (34.3%). People don't reject exercise — they stall when it feels like a chore.
Ryan et al.(1997)은 운동 지속이 건강이나 외모 같은 외부: Ryan et al. (1997): adherence ties more to intrinsic motives — enjoyment, competence, connection — than looks.
2026년 Valeo와 Infineon은 MEMS 기반 Laser Bea: In 2026 Valeo and Infineon showed a MEMS laser floor-projection module — brighter for daylight, with full color on the roadmap.[1][2] (Valeo)
기존 허리 장착형 프로젝터 연구는 걷는 중 작은 모바일 화면을 계속 봐야: A hip-mounted projector study put info on the floor to avoid staring at a phone while walking; gait-synced stabilization improved visibility.[1] (J-STAGE)
C-Mill 연구는 treadmill 위에 타깃과 장애물을 투사해, 사용: C-Mill projected targets on a treadmill to train foot adjustment; 16 chronic-stroke patients improved gait and balance and raised activity 19.6%.[1] (MJS Publishing)
2023년 연구는 파킨슨병 환자에게 wearable laser visua: A 2023 study gave Parkinson's patients a wearable laser cue; gait improved at once — longer stride, higher toe lift, less double support.[1] (Frontiers)
또 다른 연구는 사용자가 걷는 동안 보폭 정보를 바닥에 투사하는 자가 보: Another study projected stride info on the floor for self gait training; 10 healthy elders (76–91) showed better stride control and accepted it.[2] (ResearchGate)
관찰 학습 연구에서도 복잡한 움직임은 시각 모델을 통해 더 잘 전달될 수: Observational learning conveys complex moves well; a PLOS ONE study found it helps learners form a perceptual blueprint of the move.[1] (PLOS)

NEWTON은 이러한 소프트 엑소슈트의 원리를 적용하여, 최소한의 구조만: NEWTON applies that soft-exosuit principle: minimal structure, gait left intact, push only when needed.
NEWTON은 종아리 측면에 장착되는 폼팩터 특성상, 강한 충격에도 프로: Mounted on the calf side, the projector must not shake loose under impact, and the projected UI must hold its place.
실험 결과, 목표 투사 영역을 가장 안정적으로 커버하는 부위는 고관절(3: Testing narrowed it to three — hip (30°), thigh (45°), knee (60°/45°) — as the most reliable coverage.
또한 지면-발 간의 상호작용 연구에서는 디딤발 말단부의 정밀한 각도 제어: Foot–ground research shows precise angle control at the planted foot maximizes ground reaction force, the mechanism behind real performance gaps.[2]
NEWTON은 최소한의 폼팩터로 사용자가 본래 가진 보행 습관을 해치지: A minimal form factor assists without disturbing the gait you already have, making the movement you want easier to reach.
즉, NEWTON은 전자 영구 자석(EPM)을 통한 안정적인 모듈 결합과: So the projection is secured twice: an electropermanent magnet (EPM) holds the module, a gimbal with OIS holds the image.
이후 모터, 빔 프로젝터, 배터리, 하단 와이어 연결부 등 핵심 부품의: Dummy mockups at the true size of motor, projector, battery and lower wire joint confirmed the scale NEWTON needed.
이러한 기술적 특성은 지면을 강하게 딛거나 다리를 빠르게 스윙하는 하체: That is the firmest evidence the projector will not break away, even under hard footfalls and fast leg swings.
고관절 투사 시 발생하는 손과 허벅지에 의한 빛 가림 문제를 해결하고,: To clear the hand and thigh blocking a hip-mounted beam, and to beat the inertial lag of a sharp turn, NEWTON settled on the knee.
실제로 주행 및 절단 동작 중 발목-무릎-골반으로 이어지는 운동학적 회전: In the ankle–knee–pelvis rotation order during running and cutting, the knee acts as an antenna, steering the next step just before landing.[1]
보행 주기 중 발을 지면에서 떼며 앞으로 치고 나아가는 동작에서 종아리: Through push-off the calf and Achilles carry the heaviest load. Lifting the heel by wire adds push at exactly that moment.
하지만 고관절이나 허리 부근에서 지면으로 빛을 쏘면, 역동적으로 움직이는: A beam from the hip or waist catches on a moving hand, elbow, or bending thigh. From the knee it sidesteps that interference and stays clear.
보조력을 얻기 위해 필요한 건 거창한 프레임이 아닌, 사용자가 자연스럽게: Assistance needs the right intervention in the right place, not a grand frame. Rigid-frame exoskeletons are heavy, feel foreign, and cost you freedom of gait.
인간이 주행 중 급격하게 방향을 전환할 때, 발목과 무릎이 진행 방향으로: Cutting hard mid-run, the ankle and knee turn first; pelvis and torso follow. On a hip mount the leg has turned while the beam still points ahead.
먼저 하체에 부착될 빔 프로젝터로 발 앞 20cm~150cm 범위의 시야: To cover 20–150 cm ahead of the foot while holding aim at a centre 50–85 cm out, we fired lasers from five body positions at 90°, 60°, 45°, 30°, 15°.
순간 전력 제어로 발열 없이 강력한 체결력 유지 NEWTON의 프로젝터: The coupling uses the EPM found in drone cargo hooks and industrial robot arms. Unlike an ordinary electromagnet, EPM draws power only in the brief moment of attaching or releasing.[1]
보행 및 러닝과 같은 동적 활동에서 인간은 지면 위에 제공되는 시각적 단: Walking and running, people keep reading ground cues to regulate movement. Cut that guide even briefly and continuity breaks, raising uncertainty and cognitive load.[1]
멋진 움직임을 따라 하고 싶은 유저가 뻣뻣한 움직임에서 벗어나 프로처럼: It frees a user copying a great move from stiffness, cuts a pro's ankle snap, and stops force leaking into the ground. The wire drive that pulls the heel also requires it structurally.
Running swings the calf through wide angles and vibrates it at once. A micro gimbal corrects the large attitude changes first[1], and OIS on the lens cleans up the fine vibration.
체결이 유지되는 동안에는 전력 소모나 발열이 전혀 발생하지 않으면서도 익: While it holds there is no power draw and no heat, yet it takes extreme-sport vibration and load. No wrenching it off either — one button drops the magnetism and it slides apart.
NEWTON은 제품 양측에 장착된 듀얼 모터를 통해 작동합니다. 사용자가: Dual motors, one each side. As you step forward the wire lifts the back of your heel at the right moment. Instead of heavy hardware, motor torque becomes wire tension and push goes straight to the body.
내장된 자이로 센서가 착용자의 움직임을 실시간으로 감지하면, 짐벌은 프로: The gyro reads movement in real time; the gimbal holds the projector's attitude[1] while OIS shifts the lens to cut axis shake. The two stages together keep the projected graphic in place through hard movement.
일반적인 물리적 결합이나 고정형 렌즈로는 발을 내디딜 때 발생하는 둔탁한: A fixed lens and ordinary coupling risk the module dropping under each footfall's blunt shock. Against the skin, drawing continuous power to hold harder makes heat that hurts usability. It needs to hold hard, stay safe, and correct optics instantly.
신체 운동 사슬 연구에 따르면, 하체 근육군에서 생성된 에너지가 지면으로: Kinetic chain research shows that when the ankle and distal foot joints fail to steer precisely, much of the power made in the lower body leaks before reaching the ground.[1] Beginners especially cannot carry hip force to the sole; the planted foot twists and power drains.
하버드 대학 연구팀의 소프트 엑소스쿠트 생체역학 연구에 따르면, 텍스타일: In Harvard's soft exosuit work, assisting the ankle with textile and cable tension cut walking's metabolic energy by up to about 23% (22.83 ± 3.17%).[1] Wire-based ankle assist alone, no rigid frame, meaningfully lowers what walking costs.
무인 항공기와 로보틱스 분야의 'Design and Control of: 'Design and Control of an Electropermanent Magnet Gripper for Aerial Manipulation' showed EPM coupling holds a payload without separating through in-flight vibration, abrupt acceleration, and heavy vertical and horizontal loads.[1]
NEWTON의 타깃은 신체 기능 회복이 필요한 환자가 아니라, 운동 동작: NEWTON is not for patients recovering function but for beginners and lightly active users who want a movement done properly. What separates amateur from pro is segmenting — pivoting on the knee to snap the ankle through a direction change. Research on sprinting and cutting finds ankle stiffness and mobility central to final force transfer and tempo control.[1]

The app is where today's play is chosen and recorded. Browse the sports you care about, set the mode and intensity your body is up for. Afterwards a report shows the rhythm and the change, and hands you the cue for the next play.
서브 타입으로 사용되는 OffBit Trial Dot Bold는 움직임을: The sub type, OffBit Trial Dot Bold, renders the small signals of movement as dots. As one dot is recorded, joined, and grows into a larger flow, the type system shows movement stacking into data and returning as play.
Newton uses a gradient where light and heat carry into each other. Rising dawn is the moment a movement begins; heat still unspent at night is the will to keep going. Red bleeding into soft light traces how a movement once watched becomes play.
Newton의 로고는 비록 서툴더라도 멋진 움직임을 따라가고 싶은 라이트: The logo looks like a light user who wants to follow a great move, however clumsily. The lower body running forward became the wearable's symbol — the moment a play watched through a screen is tried with your own body. What matters more than perfect form is wanting to move now. Newton starts that first turn with you.
우리는 매일 새로운 스포츠 트렌드를 마주하고, 그것에 몰입한 나를 상상해: Every day we meet a new sports trend and picture ourselves inside it. But between that and moving sits more hesitation than we expect. Newton is lower-body wearable robotics that lets you try the movement on screen with your own body before the interest fades. It starts where the body pushes forward and reads impact and balance first, so unfamiliar movement can be followed at your own speed and range. As the scientist Newton found an order no one could see, Newton lets sport that felt far away be lived again on your body and the ground. If your heart has moved, it is your turn.

Newton starts from the experience of beginning a sport and taking it on. But at its centre is not one discipline — it is a structure that lets you start an unfamiliar movement at your own body's pace. That reach runs past running, boxing and basketball, all the way to learning balance again and recovering the feel of walking. So that anyone can trust their turn and take on a new movement.

낯선 움직임을 무리 없이 시작하게 하는 기본 안전 모드: The default safety mode, for easing into an unfamiliar movement
발목과 하체 움직임의 과한 범위를 잡고, 와이어 장력으로 흔들림을 제한: Reins in excess ankle and lower-body range, and damps wobble with wire tension
발목이 덜 꺾이고, 착지와 방향 전환이 안정적으로 느껴짐: The ankle rolls less; landings and turns feel steady
꺼지는 리듬을 다시 앞으로 이어주는 추진 보조 모드: A propulsion assist that carries a fading rhythm forward
발뒤꿈치가 지면에서 떨어지고 앞으로 치고 나가는 순간: As the heel leaves the ground and you drive forward
와이어 장력으로 발목 중심축을 보조해 뒤꿈치를 위로 끌어올림: Wire tension supports the ankle's axis and lifts the heel
다음 발이 더 쉽게 나가고, 후반 리듬이 끊기지 않음: The next step comes easier; the late rhythm holds
반복 구간에 일부러 묵직한 저항을 더하는 훈련 모드: A training mode that adds deliberate, heavy resistance to repeated work
다리를 앞으로 내밀거나 스윙하는 구간: While the leg swings or reaches forward
와이어가 순순히 풀리지 않도록 역방향 브레이크를 걸어 저항 생성: Brakes the wire against you so it will not pay out freely
모래주머니를 찬 듯 묵직하게 잡히고, 반복 후 몸이 더 가볍게 느껴짐: It drags like ankle weights, and the body feels lighter after
집 안에서도 사뿐히 움직이게 하는 실내 착지 모드: An indoor landing mode, for moving lightly inside the house
발이 지면에 닿기 직전부터 뒤꿈치가 완전히 닿는 순간: From just before the foot meets the floor until the heel is fully down
와이어를 미세하게 풀어 체중 일부를 위에서 받치고 착지를 부드럽게 감속: Pays the wire out finely, carrying some weight from above to slow the landing
